learnings.summary: Always do delta reviews for re-reviewed PRs, never full reviews from scratch
learnings.detail: When triage flags a PR as re-review (new commits since last review), do NOT spawn a fresh reviewer that re-discovers all issues from scratch. Instead: (1) Fetch the previous review we posted on that PR using gh api repos/REPO/pulls/NUMBER/reviews and extract our last review body. (2) Include previous findings in the reviewer prompt as context. (3) Ask the reviewer to focus ONLY on: were previous findings addressed? are there NEW issues? (4) Only post a new review if the delta is meaningful (new findings, or fixes confirmed). This avoids duplicate noise, saves subagent budget, and respects the PR author's time.

learnings.summary: Skip posting reviews for rebase-only re-reviews with no content changes
learnings.detail: When a re-review shows the PR was only rebased with no content changes, do not post a new review. Just update state. The previous review's findings still apply and are already visible on the PR.
